successCriteria.description: LeaveListPage renders a "Request leave" link (react-router-dom `Link`) targeting `/leaves/new`, and the link is reachable in every render state — error, loading, empty list, and populated list — not only inside the populated-list branch.

App.tsx registers a `/leaves/new` route wrapped in `RequireAuth` that renders `RequestLeavePage` with `leaveService={leaveService}`, and the route is declared before the existing `/leaves/:id` route so `new` is not captured as an `:id` parameter.

web/src/presentation/index.ts re-exports `RequestLeavePage` (value) and `RequestLeavePageProps` (type) alongside the existing page exports, following the established `export { X }` / `export type { XProps }` pattern.

constraints: Do not modify web/src/main.tsx — it already injects `employeeService` and `leaveService` into `<App>`; no composition-root change is required for this phase.
Keep the existing list rendering in LeaveListPage.tsx intact — the "Request leave" link is additive and must not alter the existing error/loading/empty/list markup or their early-return structure.

The `/leaves/new` route must be wrapped in `RequireAuth` (like the other protected routes) and must be registered before `/leaves/:id` so the literal segment `new` is not matched as an `:id` parameter.
Do not modify RequestLeavePage.tsx or LeaveDetailPage.tsx — this phase only wires the already-built page into routing and exports; the page's props and navigation contract are fixed by Phases 3–4.
outOfScope: No changes to web/src/main.tsx — service injection is already complete and out of scope for this phase.
No changes to RequestLeavePage.tsx or LeaveDetailPage.tsx — their form, validation, action, and navigation behavior are fixed by Phases 3–4 and are not re-opened here.
No new service methods, API client endpoints, or backend changes — this phase is presentation-layer wiring only.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The `/leaves/new` route must pass `leaveService` from the existing `AppProps.leaveService` (type `ILeaveService`), matching the prop contract `RequestLeavePageProps.leaveService` declared in RequestLeavePage.tsx.
The `/leaves/:id` route must continue to pass both `leaveService` and `employeeService` to `LeaveDetailPage`, matching the `LeaveDetailPageProps` contract established in Phase 4.
The barrel re-exports must use the same `export { X }` / `export type { XProps }` style as the existing page exports in the file.
The "Request leave" link must use the `Link` component already imported from `react-router-dom` in LeaveListPage.tsx and target the literal path `/leaves/new`.

integrationPoints.why: The page component and its `RequestLeavePageProps` are the subject being wired into the route and barrel; its `leaveService` prop and `/leaves/${id}` success navigation are the contract this phase must satisfy.
The `/leaves/:id` route already passes `employeeService` (Phase 4); this phase must preserve that wiring and ensure `/leaves/new` is matched before it.
Composition root already injects `leaveService` (and `employeeService`) into `<App>`; no change is needed, but the new route depends on that existing injection.
